notes.title: 🌟 Playtest Access Update! 🌟
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who signed up for early access to our demo! We're excited to announce that the playtest has officially begun for some lucky players. A total of 50 individuals now have access to the demo, with more slots opening up next weekend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911037/b649eaf59ac63bfd1621e49ab127395f0f72f9ad.gif[/img]

🎮 You can stream the demo or create video content about it. Help spread the word by encouraging your friends to add our game to their wishlist—it means the world to us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43601208/c69cab8334976f7cc099688f3ae973dd6e2e2be5.gif[/img]

📆 Stay tuned for updates on the release dates for both [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2133830/UNFOLLOW/]UNFOLLOW[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2846530/FOLLOW/]FOLLOW[/url]. 
We'll announce them as soon as the playtest phase concludes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911037/2ed007519fd27c6b5bab689505d755933158f755.gif[/img]

Thank you for your incredible support! Let's make this journey together.

[b]WISHLIST NOW[/b]
